_about: Script pipelines: tabs whose backend runs a script (not ComfyUI).
Read only by app/pipelines.py. workflows.json, start.sh and gen_config.py never
see this file, so nothing here can change the ComfyUI tabs.
One entry = one tab. The worker for each lives in pipelines/<name>/ and is started
Uploads: needs_image = a reference image; media = what the main upload is
(audio or video); needs_audio = an extra audio upload (dubbing: video + audio).
default_prompt: the prompt every job uses. With needs_prompt false it is fixed:
users never see or change it.
max_input_minutes: longest video/audio accepted (checked in the page and by the worker).
labels: captions in the gallery and History (image, video, audio, result).
notes: short points shown as a list under the tab's description.
args: the fixed command-line settings of the script; users never change them.
Keys are the script's options with _ instead of -, e.g. max_seconds -> --max-seconds.
true = flag on, null = script default.

lipsync.label: Img Lipsync
lipsync.blurb: Makes the person in your image speak your audio, with accurate lip sync. Upload a reference image and a speech audio file.
notes: Each half minute of audio takes around 1 hour to process, so the longer the audio, the longer the wait.
Audio longer than 1 minute is cut at 1 minute.
lipsync.gallery_blurb: Examples of image lip sync: the reference image and the talking video made from it.
lipsync.default_prompt: A photorealistic video of the person in the reference image speaking naturally and clearly to the camera, looking directly into the camera lens with steady eye contact and natural blinking. Accurate lip sync, with natural, clean and clearly defined teeth preserved exactly as in the reference image. Calm, subtle facial expressions and small, gentle natural head movements, with no exaggerated, sudden or large motions. Static camera with fixed framing, no zoom in, no zoom out and no camera movement. Face, hair, clothing, background and lighting stay exactly the same as in the reference image, natural skin texture.

dubbing.label: Video Lipsync
dubbing.blurb: Gives an existing video a new voice: the speaker's lips are re-synced to the audio you upload, while their face, motion and background stay the same. Upload the video and the dubbed speech audio, each up to 30 minutes.
notes: The video should show 1 or 2 people.
One minute of video takes around 6 minutes to generate, so processing time grows heavily as the video and audio get longer.
dubbing.gallery_blurb: Examples of video lip sync: the original video and the result with the lips re-synced to the new audio.
